query:
UPDATE principals
               SET kind = 'external', user_id = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
               WHERE company_id = $1 AND user_id = $2
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM company_members AS member
                     WHERE member.company_id = $1 AND member.user_id = $2
                       AND member.role <> 'owner'
                 )
